title: Harken
description: Harken MQTT runtime: traffic, handlers, outbox, leader election and processes.

panels.title: Leaders
panels.description: Replicas that hold the leader lock. Exactly one should while leader routes, NOTIFY channels or timers exist.

panels.title: Replicas
panels.description: Runtime processes reporting metrics.

panels.title: Broker connections up
panels.description: Connected main and leader connections over all replicas.

panels.title: Outbox waiting
panels.description: Entries waiting in the outbox streams.

panels.title: Received / s
panels.description: Inbound MQTT messages per second, all replicas.

panels.title: Handler failures (range)
panels.description: Handler runs that threw during the selected time range.

panels.title: Received / s
panels.description: Inbound messages per second by replica and connection (main: shared and broadcast routes, leader: leader routes).

panels.title: Published / s
panels.description: Messages published per second by replica (handlers, timers and the outbox).

panels.title: Handled / s
panels.description: Messages handled per second by route, and PostgreSQL notifications by channel.

panels.title: Handler time p99
panels.description: Time an inline handler (or the hand-off of a ->queued() one) takes on the event loop. Everything else in the process waits meanwhile.

panels.title: Failed, slow and unmatched / s
panels.description: Handler runs that threw or went over the slow threshold, and messages no route matched.

panels.title: Waiting
panels.description: Entries waiting in each outbox stream (Harken::publish() outside the runtime).

panels.title: Published and dropped / s
panels.description: Entries published (and acknowledged by the broker) or dropped (malformed or refused for good).

panels.title: Latency
panels.description: From XADD to the broker acknowledging the publish.

panels.title: Leader by replica
panels.description: 1 while a replica holds the leader lock.

panels.title: Takeovers (range)
panels.description: Times a replica became leader during the selected time range.

panels.title: Last gap
panels.description: How long no replica received leader routes before the current leader took over: from the previous leader's last sign of life to the current one receiving. About the lease after a crash, under a second after a graceful stop.

panels.title: Last takeover
panels.description: From the current leader taking the lock to its leader connection being subscribed.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Memory allocated by each runtime process.

panels.title: Loop lag
panels.description: How late the status heartbeat timer fired: time the event loop was busy.

panels.title: Reconnects
panels.description: Successful reconnects to the broker.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Time since each runtime process started.

panels.title: Dropped deliveries / s
panels.description: Messages EMQX dropped because a session queue was full (mqtt.max_mqueue_len). Needs EMQX scraped by the same Prometheus (/api/v5/prometheus/stats).

panels.title: Broker messages / s
panels.description: Messages EMQX received from and delivered to clients.
